notes.title: SPARK OF NATURE 2.0 IS HERE!
notes.content:
[b]Hello! Its been a while![/b]


The wait is over! here's the new update bringing new mechanics and some updates on the levels!

[h1]Levels Rework[/h1]

[b]The Cabin[/b] we made a total redesign, scaling every item to make it more natural.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899216/24a9f4e594de6ce8d9c7e4ff3c99e6b0a115fd00.png[/img]
[b]The Garden[/b] Is now a complete playable level, with a complete visual update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899216/f0ea34844d5596528ec3742c0110400c3bedf144.png[/img]
[h1]Core Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] We added a [b]Quest System[/b] in every level so you keep track of what to do.
[*] We added a [b]Final Level Screen[/b] to see your score after ending the level.
[*] Minor changes to Aloe's movement speed.
[*] Aloe can no longer doble jump in a normal state, but we increased the jump so its easier to reach certain places.
[*] Aloe now can use [b]a Stick[/b] to break objects.
[*] Aloe can now enter [b]Hidratation Mode[/b], allowing him to increase his movement speed and double jump for a short period of time.
[*] [b]Brand New Intro Cinematic[/b] when you first start the game.
[*] The following levels has been removed: [b]The Lobby[/b], [b]The Basement[/b]
[*] The Skin selection has been disabled.
[/list]

notes.title: Spark Of Nature: Aloe and the Dragon | Everything you need to know
notes.content:
Spark Of Nature: Aloe and The Dragon event is here. From April 23 to May 7 at 5:00 p.m CEST

[previewyoutube=iIkjVLxfH1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]About the event[/h3]
Welcome to the magical celebration of Sant Jordi in Catalonia! It's a day filled with love, literature, and legends. Imagine colorful streets buzzing with excitement, where everyone shares smiles and stories.

So, in we captured the spirit of Sant Jordi. You'll embark on a journey through vibrant levels, helping dying roses to bloom and defeat the dragon. It's not just about saving the day; it's about spreading love and kindness wherever you go.

Get ready to dive into a world of adventure, friendship, and maybe even a little bit of magic. Because in Catalonia, every day is a celebration of love and courage, just like Sant Jordi himself!

[h3]Dying Roses[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899216/0365c0fe636875f6d45cd8be5f0f449355279e20.png[/img]

In the event "Aloe and the Dragon," your mission is to find a total of 20 dying roses spread across two levels: "The Cabin" and "The Basement." As you explore these levels, you'll come across these wilted roses. But fear not! You can approach each rose and use Aloe's special ability to help them bloom again. It's like giving them a magical hug! By reviving these roses, you're not only progressing through the game but also spreading love and beauty in the world of Aloe. So, keep your eyes peeled for those precious roses and bring them back to life with your caring touch!

[h3]The Dragon[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899216/ce20de61bd8ae0b70047d4ec7596458fe2248800.png[/img]

Once you've helped all 20 roses bloom within the game, something truly magical happens! You'll face off against the fearsome dragon, just like in the legend of Sant Jordi. But here's the twist: instead of fighting, your act of kindness transforms the dragon into a symbol of beauty and love, you want to know what happens? Dive in Spark Of Nature!

notes.title: SPARK OF NATURE - SPROUTING INTO STEAM!
notes.content:
[b]
SPARK OF NATURE IS ON STEAM![/b]

Spark of Nature is a 3rd person platform game where you play the journey of a curious Aloe Vera plant.

[b]What can you expect for the early access version?[/b]

- 2 Full Complete Levels: [b]"The Cabin"[/b], and [b]"The Basement"[/b].

- [b]"The Lobby"[/b], where you can travel to levels and customize your Aloe.

- [b]Hidden Content[/b], such as skins for Aloe, and secret levels.

- Full game avaliable in [b]English[/b] and [b]Spanish[/b]( and more to come in later versions).

- [b]Original Soundtracks[/b] for every level.


[b]Why early access?[/b]

We wanted to make this game as enjoyable as possible, and listen from day one, what the players are looking from an indie Platform game, so we are planning to make surveys and community posts about the progress of the game and what's to come, so we can shape this game together as a team!

Thank you so much for giving our game a try and we hope that you enjoy the adventure of our little protagonist.

[b]Remember this game releases 25th of March, just 10 days away![/b]


Take care,

[b]The team of Spark Of Nature.[/b]
